
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yhy2013/p/23190131" title="发布于 2026-10-03 10:42">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">费马小定理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3462795/202610/3462795-20261002113649844-1476903063.png" alt="费马小定理" class="desc_img">
        费马小定理
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="定理">定理</h2>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 是质数，且整数 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 满足 <span class="math inline">\(\boldsymbol{a \not\equiv 0 \pmod p}\)</span>，则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod p
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="变形">变形</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(a^{p-2} \equiv a^{-1} \pmod p\)</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(a^b \equiv a^{b \bmod (p-1)} \pmod p\)</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p>前提：p为质数</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="运用">运用</h2>
<h3 id="乘法逆元">乘法逆元</h3>
<p>在模质数 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 意义下，除法不能直接算，要乘逆元：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{x}{y} \pmod p = x \times y^{-1} \pmod p
\]</div><p></p><p>由费马：<span class="math inline">\(y^{-1}=y^{p-2}\pmod p\)</span>，用<strong>快速幂</strong>计算。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>适用场景：组合数 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{C}_n^k \bmod p\)</span>，p为质数。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="快速幂降幂">快速幂降幂</h3>
<p>求 <span class="math inline">\(a^b \bmod p\)</span>，当 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 极大，p质数，a、p互质：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a^b \equiv a^{b \bmod (p-1)} \pmod p
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="素数测试">素数测试</h3>
<p>随机选若干个a，检验 <span class="math inline">\(a^{p-1}\equiv1\pmod p\)</span></p>
<p>满足<strong>大概率</strong>（存在伪素数）是质数，不满足一定是合数。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="模版">模版</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef long long ll;
ll qpow(ll a,ll b,ll mod){
    ll res=1;
    while(b){
        if(b&amp;1) res=res*a%mod;
        a=a*a%mod;
        b&gt;&gt;=1;
    }
    return res;
}
// 求a在模质数p下逆元
ll inv(ll a,ll p){
    return qpow(a,p-2,p);
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="例题">例题</h2>
<h3 id="p2613">P2613</h3>
<p>题目：给出 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,p\)</span>，求 <span class="math inline">\(\dfrac{a}{b} \bmod 19260817\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(19260817\)</span>是质数。</p>
<p>式子：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{a}{b} \equiv a \times b^{mod-2} \pmod{mod}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="片段">片段：</h4>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int mod=19260817;
ll a,b;
cin&gt;&gt;a&gt;&gt;b;
ll ans=a%mod * qpow(b,mod-2,mod)%mod;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="p3811">P3811</h3>
<p>单点求逆元用费马快速幂</p>
<p>但本题n范围大 <span class="math inline">\(1\le n\le 3\times10^6\)</span>，费马快速幂会TLE，要用线性递推逆元。</p>


</div>
